title.en: An Act Creating the City of Cadiz
title.orig: An act amending Section 2 of Republic Act No. 4894 otherwise known as "An Act Creating the City of Cadiz," and for other purposes
title.vi: Đạo luật thành lập Thành phố Cadiz
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งเมือง Cadiz

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2004/ra_9248_2004.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The above described lots together with the appurtenances thereto shall belong to the City of Cadiz and thereafter said lots may be sold or leased under such rules and regulations as the city government may promulgate.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
